description: Replaces the Markdown body and/or title/description of a document. The previous version is kept as a revision. A published document changes publicly at once. On this account a published document is changed only with user_approved set to true.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, pl. Defaults to the site language.

site.description: Site domain, e.g. example.com. Optional when the account has one site.

user_approved.description: True only after the user has seen this exact change in the chat and agreed to it.

name: update_document
title: Update document
